MASTER AI PROMPT — COX ELEMENTARY PTA WEBSITE
You are a professional UX designer, front-end web developer, and behavioral psychologist specializing in educational community engagement websites.

Your task is to build a modern, mobile-first PTA website for Cox Elementary School that increases parent engagement, volunteer sign-ups, and event participation using psychology-based design principles.

🏫 SCHOOL CONTEXT
School: Cox Elementary PTA
Audience: Parents, guardians, teachers, and community members
Goal: Increase engagement, volunteer participation, and awareness of school events and newsletters.

Tone: Warm, welcoming, community-centered, emotionally engaging but still professional.

🧠 PSYCHOLOGY & UX REQUIREMENTS
Design the website using these behavioral principles:

Cognitive ease → simple navigation, minimal clutter, scannable content
Chunking → break all information into small sections and cards
Visual hierarchy → users should understand the page in under 10 seconds
Emotional engagement → use warm, community-driven language
Behavior nudges → clear CTAs like “Volunteer”, “Join”, “RSVP”
Social proof → include participation indicators (e.g., “120+ volunteers”)
Progress effect → show continuity via newsletters and event history
Low friction design → reduce form fields and barriers to action
🌐 REQUIRED SITE STRUCTURE
Create a multi-page website with the following pages:

🏠 HOME PAGE
Hero Section
Title: COX ELEMENTARY PTA
Subtitle: Building connection. Supporting students. Strengthening community.
Buttons:
View Events
Volunteer
Latest Newsletter
Impact Section (Social Proof)
Include metrics such as:

120+ parent volunteers
3+ school events supported monthly
Student-centered fundraising impact
Upcoming Event Highlight
Feature:

Scholastic Book Fair (May 26–29)
Include note: “Teacher wishlists available — students can help support teachers”
Why PTA Matters Section
Explain emotional/educational impact:

Improved student confidence
Stronger academic support
Better school-community connection
🤝 VOLUNTEER PAGE
Create a volunteer page optimized for low-pressure participation.

Heading:
Volunteer With Cox PTA

Messaging:
“Small time commitment. Big impact.”

Volunteer Options (as cards or buttons):
Book Fair Helper (1–2 hours)
Event Setup Crew
Teacher Appreciation Support
Communications / Social Media Help
On-call flexible volunteer list
Psychology Requirement:
Make volunteering feel:

simple
flexible
non-intimidating
Add social proof like:
“Even one hour helps make a difference.”

CTA:
“Join the Volunteer List”

📅 EVENTS PAGE
Design a clean, filterable event calendar.

Include:

Events:
Scholastic Book Fair (May 26–29)
Jump for Jackets Drive (May 29, 3–5 PM)
PTA General Meeting (May 20, 2026)
Features:
Event cards with date + description
Filter buttons (Family Events, Fundraisers, Meetings)
Mobile-friendly layout
Psychology:
Make events feel:

easy to understand
visually organized
emotionally meaningful
📰 NEWSLETTER PAGE
Create a newsletter hub.

Structure:
Latest newsletter (May 2026 – “Growing Together 🌱”)
Download button or preview card
Newsletter sections:
Upcoming events
Volunteer highlights
Teacher appreciation updates
Student achievement spotlight
Archive:
Previous months listed in simple cards
CTA:
“Subscribe for PTA Updates”

🧑‍🏫 ABOUT PAGE
Explain PTA mission in simple emotional language.

Include:

Mission:
Support students
Fund enrichment programs
Build school spirit
Strengthen communication
Values section:
Every child deserves support
Families make a difference
Community strengthens education
📞 CONTACT PAGE
Keep extremely simple:

Email contact
PTA leadership contact
Optional social links
Minimize friction for communication.

🎨 DESIGN STYLE REQUIREMENTS
Mobile-first responsive design
Clean, modern UI
Soft friendly color palette (school-appropriate)
Rounded cards and buttons
Clear icons for navigation
Light animations (fade/slide-in, subtle hover effects)
Highly readable typography
🚀 FINAL OUTPUT REQUIREMENTS
Generate:

A fully functional multi-page website
Modern UI suitable for school PTA use
Ready to publish or export
Optimized for mobile and desktop
Clean navigation menu linking all pages
⚡ EXTRA (IMPORTANT)
Make the site feel:

welcoming, not corporate
community-driven, not administrative
emotionally engaging for parents
easy enough that any parent can navigate it in under 10 seconds
